game.title: Buzkashi
game.description: The national sport of Afghanistan, Buzkashi is a dramatic horseback game where skilled riders, known as 'Chapandaz,' compete to grab a headless goat or calf carcass and carry it around a flag before dropping it in a designated circle.
howToPlay: Step 1: Two teams line up on a large field, with a flag or circle at each end serving as the goal.
Step 2: A headless carcass is placed in the center of the field by referees.
Step 3: On signal, riders charge to grab the carcass from the ground while mounted.
Step 4: The rider who secures the carcass attempts to carry it around the opposing team's flag and drop it into their scoring circle.
Step 5: Other riders try to tackle the carrier or steal the carcass through physical combat.
Step 6: Riders must maintain control of their horses while handling the heavy carcass.
Step 7: Points are awarded when a rider successfully circles the flag and deposits the carcass.
Step 8: The game continues for several hours or until a predetermined score is reached.
Step 9: Skilled Chapandaz are celebrated as local heroes with their horses decorated elaborately.
Step 10: Matches are often accompanied by traditional music and large community gatherings.
